description:
## Features

### YouTube - Built-in downloader
- **Downloads play in YouTube's own player:** tapping a download in the offline library (or the download finished notification) now opens the video in the real YouTube watch page and plays the downloaded file. Comments, related videos, SponsorBlock, Return YouTube Dislike and the other player buttons work for it. The saved resume position is used and updated while it plays.
- **Needs the internet, falls back to the built-in player:** the watch page loads from YouTube, so with no connection, for a file this device cannot decode (AV1/VP9), when `Spoof video streams` is not part of the build, or with the new `Play downloads in YouTube's player` setting off, the built-in player opens as before.
- **New long-press entry:** `Play in built-in player` in the menu of a download (shown while the setting is on).

## Notes
- Background playback from the notification still uses the built-in player.
- The download is served to YouTube from a loopback-only server with a random per-launch token, so other apps cannot read it.

## Compatibility
- YouTube: **21.39.525, 21.13.164, 20.05.46**.
- YouTube Music: **9.40.51, 9.15.51, 8.30.54**.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/lavinhoque33/revanced-patches/compare/v1.10.2...v1.10.3)
